cases.sentence: Люби Господа своего ___ и всегда соблюдай Его требования
cases.translation: Love the Lord your God and always keep His requirements
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'люби' (love) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: I do not speak to your children
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (to) governs the dative case for the indirect object.

cases.sentence: Вспомните сегодня Его величие, Его могучую длань и простертую руку в ___
cases.translation: Remember today His greatness, His mighty hand and His outstretched arm in Egypt
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with prepositional case indicates location or place where an event occurred.

cases.sentence: земля, куда вы вступаете, чтобы завладеть ею, это земля гор и ___
cases.translation: the land where you are going to possess is a land of hills and valleys
cases.explain: In the coordinate phrase 'гор и долин' (hills and valleys), both nouns are in the genitive case with 'земля'.

cases.translation: which drinks rain from the sky
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (from) with genitive case expresses the source or origin of something.

cases.sentence: Взгляд Господа твоего Бога круглый год обращен на ___
cases.translation: The eyes of the Lord your God are always on the land
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with accusative case indicates direction toward a place or object.

cases.sentence: любить Господа вашего ___ и служить Ему от всего сердца
cases.translation: to love the Lord your God and serve Him with all your heart
cases.explain: The verbs 'любить' (love) and 'служить' (serve) both govern the accusative case.

cases.translation: See, I set before you today a blessing
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'предлагаю' (offer/set before) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

reading.ru: Люби Господа своего Бога и всегда соблюдай Его требования, установления и повеления.
reading.question: What are the people commanded to do?
options: Forget God and pursue their own desires
Love God and always keep His requirements and commandments
Serve other gods and follow foreign customs
Build temples and offer sacrifices without ceasing
reading.correct: Love God and always keep His requirements and commandments
reading.explain: The text directly commands 'Люби Господа своего Бога и всегда соблюдай Его требования, установления и повеления' (Love the Lord your God and always keep His requirements, statutes, and commandments).

reading.ru: Я не обращаюсь к вашим детям, которые не знали и не видели наказания Господа вашего Бога.
reading.question: Who does Moses not address in this speech?
options: The children who did not experience God's discipline in Egypt
reading.correct: The children who did not experience God's discipline in Egypt
reading.explain: Moses states 'Я не обращаюсь к вашим детям, которые не знали и не видели наказания' (I do not speak to your children who did not know and did not see God's discipline).

reading.ru: земля, куда вы вступаете, чтобы завладеть ею, это земля гор и долин, которая пьет дождь с неба.
reading.question: What kind of land is the promised land described as?
options: A flat, featureless desert requiring irrigation
A mountainous and valley land that receives rain from heaven
A tropical rainforest with dense vegetation
reading.correct: A mountainous and valley land that receives rain from heaven
reading.explain: The text describes it as 'земля гор и долин, которая пьет дождь с неба' (a land of hills and valleys which drinks rain from heaven).

reading.ru: это земля, которой заботится Господь твой Бог. Взгляд Господа твоего Бога круглый год обращен на нее.
reading.question: How does God care for this land?
options: He abandons it to grow wild without oversight
He cares for it; the eyes of the Lord are always on it throughout the year
He only watches over it during harvest time
He sends angels to guard it while He is absent
reading.correct: He cares for it; the eyes of the Lord are always on it throughout the year
reading.explain: The text states 'земля, которой заботится Господь твой Бог. Взгляд Господа твоего Бога круглый год обращен на нее' (the land which the Lord cares for; the eyes of the Lord are always on it the whole year).

reading.ru: Если вы будете верно слушаться моих повелений, которые я даю вам сегодня, любить Господа вашего Бога и служить Ему от всего сердца и от всей души, то я буду в срок посылать дожди на вашу землю.
reading.question: What will God send to the land if the people obey His commandments and love Him?
options: Plagues and curses upon the ground
Rains in their season for crops
reading.correct: Rains in their season for crops
reading.explain: The text states 'я буду в срок посылать дожди на вашу землю' (I will send rains to your land in season) as the result of obedience.

reading.ru: Смотрите, сегодня я предлагаю вам благословение и проклятие.
reading.question: What choice does Moses present to the people?
options: A choice between blessing and curse
Life in Egypt or life in Canaan
reading.correct: A choice between blessing and curse
reading.explain: Moses clearly states 'сегодня я предлагаю вам благословение и проклятие' (today I set before you a blessing and a curse).
